title: Green Drip Album Cover
coreRelationships: The ornate frame acts as a central visual container for the main text elements.
The dripping green text 'ML2' is the largest and most visually impactful element, drawing immediate attention.
The snake and money are secondary elements, positioned outside the frame but contributing to the overall theme.
The green lighting from the top casts a dramatic glow, highlighting the frame and text.
reuseFormula: Recreate a dark, high-contrast scene with an ornate frame, money, and a snake. Apply a luminous, dripping green effect to the main display text, and use condensed sans-serifs for supporting text, all in an all-caps, centered layout.
